name: Artysta
source: The artist is the first project of our group. This is a short game in which the main goal is to escape from Erasmus Sebzda. An individual for whom art is more than just a painting. His art is something more bloody and unpredictable. It is certain that you will not be able to just leave. Here skills stand on a par with luck, because thanks to him we are able to get to one of two endings.
